cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mark the raffle draw as checked and random. Please keep the winning ticket separate from the unused ones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You folded your ticket in quarters. The others are flat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A storage fold isn't a selection method. Record the drawn number, not the way I carried it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Close your eyes. I'll put it back and you can prove you can't find it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a second draw. Please don't contaminate the completed one with a new procedure. Seal the winning ticket as it is; I'll sign the result.
